crossRefs.note: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,
He took the twelve aside, and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written…
Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you; for they are men who are a sign: for…
It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem
The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s go also, that we may die with him.”
Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise…
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.
translations.bsb: As they were going up the road to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking ahead of them. The disciples were amazed, but those who followed were afraid. Again Jesus took the Twelve aside and began to tell them what was going to happen to Him:
translations.kjv: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
translations.asv: And they were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going before them: and they were amazed; and they that followed were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were to happen unto him,
